fields.label: OpenStreetMap tags
fields.description: One per line: key=value, optionally ;name~word|word to also require a name match (e.g. amenity=clinic;name~ayur|panchakarma).

fields.label: DataForSEO category
fields.description: A Google business category id (the free categories endpoint lists them). Blank: the search phrase is matched on the title.

fields.label: Search phrase
fields.description: What a person would type in Google Maps, e.g. resorts or ayurvedic hospitals; the place is added.
